name: Menethil Keep
summary: At Menethil Keep, Captain Stoutfist leads the militia guarding Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. Four watchtowers rise above the Alliance port.

sections.title: Bastion of the Harbor
sections.body: Menethil Keep watches over Menethil Harbor, its wooden docks, and the marshes beyond. Four stone watchtowers look across the town and bay for raiders from the sea, renegades, and swamp beasts entering the area. Inside the fortress, Captain Stoutfist directs the town militia and sets its patrols. They defend the port and Alliance interests across the region.

faq.q: What is Menethil Keep used for?
faq.answer: Menethil Keep houses the Menethil Harbor militia and the Alliance command post in the Wetlands. Captain Stoutfist leads the local garrison from its stone walls, directing the harbor’s defenses and organizing adventurers to face threats across the marsh.

faq.q: Who is in charge of Menethil Keep?
faq.answer: Captain Stoutfist commands Menethil Keep and the Menethil militia. He coordinates the harbor’s defense against Dark Iron dwarf raiders, marsh beasts, and pirates.
Menethil Keep stands inside Menethil Harbor on the Wetlands’ western coast. Its four tall stone towers rise above the settlement.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler arriving by ship from Kalimdor or heading north toward Ironforge and Arathi, you can look to Menethil Keep for military protection at this vital transport hub.
